name: Selvara Phase 3 by Emaar
overview: Selvara Phase 3 offers a rare opportunity to experience premium residential living at the Grand Polo Club & Resort. This exclusive collection features 4-bedroom villas designed to celebrate the timeless sophistication of equestrian culture. Every villa has been thoughtfully crafted to blend artistic design with purposeful living, creating a lifestyle that caters to Dubai’s most discerning homeowners.
